changes: New dose 600 g ripe whole plantain weighed with peel replaces 300 g edible flesh; no yield equivalence. Ripeness is a manual precondition, not proved by catalogue or included in cook time. Use the reviewed ground ancho at unchanged 24 g and retain all hydration water. Frozen pineapple cooks in the mole with all juice; all frying oil is retained. Separate simmering inspection and temperature/rice checks from passive time.
